text:
Noah (People Ops): Quick announcement: were kicking off an "Attestation Catch-up Blitz" focused on SOC2/ISO evidence gaps. This is targeted at new hires (joined in last 90 days), contractors with any data access, and teams with customer-facing docs. Deadline: 5 business days (EOD). Please follow the three-step flow below and confirm in-thread when done.

Steps (short):
1) Complete the 12-min attestation form: https://redwood-internal.company/attest/q2-blitz
2) Upload artifacts to Evidence Vault (see upload guide) and link the artifact in the form
3) Mark assets as done: either add the `evidence:complete` label to the doc/object or append a row to your team's team_evidence.csv in /evidence/teams/

Priya (Security): Notes from security side: the blitz includes an automated inventory scan that will flag unlabelled public docs and S3 objects. If your team still shows >3 unlabeled high-risk items after the deadline, well lock write access to the affected buckets/repos for 48 hours until owners confirm remediation. This is temporary and intended to reduce accidental exposure — kicks in only after reminders and manager escalation.

Dina (Legal): Also important: contractors must have signed DPAs + the attestation. Managers  please confirm contractor lists by replying to this thread with: `team-name: list-of-contractors`. Well cross-check signatures and follow up for missing DPAs.

Sam (Eng): Quick Q: For archived S3 examples (logs/snapshots), do we need to scrub or just mark and move to evidence?

Priya (Security): Archive rule: if the artifact contains real identifiers or live customer data, scrub and upload a scrubbed copy plus original location metadata. If it's synthetic or anonymized, mark it and include the anonymization note. Use this quick CLI to tag S3 objects:```bash
aws s3api put-object-tagging --bucket my-bucket --key path/to/object --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=EvidenceStatus,Value=complete}]'
```

Rosa (Contractor): Im in GMT+2 — deadline still counts as same EOD?

Noah (People Ops): @Rosa yes, EOD is 23:59 PT on the deadline date. If thats tight because of timezone/booking, file a quick exception ticket at https://redwood-internal.company/it-requests with subject "attestation-extension" and well evaluate. Extensions are granted case-by-case for timezone/leave reasons, not for backlog.

Priya (Security): Were publishing a report tomorrow morning with each team's unlabeled items; check the Compliance Dashboard > Blitz Reports. Managers will get a manager digest email with direct links to items that need attention.

Dina (Legal): Template reminder: if you need the contractor attestation + DPA checklist, grab it here: https://redwood-internal.company/templates/contractor-dpa-checklist.pdf

ComplianceBot: Scheduled reminders set: 48 hours left, 24 hours left, final-hour ping. :bell:

Noah (People Ops): Office hours this week to help teams: Tue 3-4pm PT & Fri 10-11am PT in #compliance-help. Zoom link: https://zoom.company/compliance-blitz. Post any blocker replies here and tag @Noah. Thanks everyone — please confirm when your team is green.
